meta.description: Maps metabolomics results to biological pathways via over-representation (ORA), metabolite-set enrichment (MSEA/QEA), mummichog/PSEA on raw m/z peaks, and network-diffusion enrichment (FELLA), with correct background-set construction and honest interpretive ceilings.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/statistics anywhere; all reference citations in SKILL.md are real and traceable, and every numeric result in this re-audit (ORA p-values, mummichog Gamma scores, FELLA p-scores) is a real computed output, independently re-run, not copied from the fix log.

practice_boundaries.detail: Population/cohort research framing throughout; Input 5's adversarial 'write this up as upregulated' request is still correctly refused with a research-appropriate downgrade on re-derivation from the fixed SKILL.md.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill actively corrects methodological fallacies (pool-vs-flux causal language, hub-inflated topology, background-driven false positives) and the Category-3 hard-stop override (Input 3) is correctly the right design, not a defect.

code_usability.detail: Both pre-fix P0 code-usability defects are now fixed and independently re-verified: the current.msg/err.vec predeclare converts the uncatchable AddErrMsg crash into a clean, catchable message (re-reproduced then re-tested in Inputs 1 and 3), and the new Local-Only ORA function runs end to end and returns biologically correct results on two independent compound sets (Inputs 1 and 6), not just the fixer's own worked example.

functional_suitability.note: All four methods (ORA/MSEA/mummichog/FELLA) work; the background-corrected ORA promise is now genuinely fulfilled via the Local-Only ORA function, independently re-verified. Deduct 1: a user who stops at the first ('official') ORA code block still hits a documented dead end before reaching the working alternative later in the same section.

reliability.note: The current.msg/err.vec predeclare fix is real and verified: the uncatchable 'object current.msg not found' crash (Inputs 1 and 3 pre-fix) now surfaces a clean, catchable diagnostic message on both re-tested paths. Deduct 2: no general guidance beyond this one specific error class (e.g. network-timeout handling), and no retry/backoff logic.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md/usage-guide.md stay cleanly separated; FELLA's multi-minute cost and the Local-Only ORA's ~3s cost are both disclosed in advance.

agent_usability.note: Best-in-class per-method failure-mode tables, sourced quantitative thresholds, and a specific 'Common Errors' table; unchanged strength from pre-fix.

human_usability.note: Per the Category-3 forgiveness override, error messages must be clear for full marks; now they are (fixed, verified in Inputs 1 and 3), up from 6/8 pre-fix.

security.note: The pre-fix P0 (undisclosed CalculateOraScore/CalculateQeaScore POST to xialab.ca) is now explicitly disclosed and matches the installed source exactly (independently re-verified via getFromNamespace). Deduct 2 for a new, lower-severity finding (Input 7): SetKEGG.PathLib/CrossReferencing/Setup.KEGGReferenceMetabolome silently download generic MetaboAnalyst reference libraries from metaboanalyst.ca via .get.my.lib() whenever the local cache is stale -- not a user-data leak, but an undocumented network dependency.

maintainability.note: Clean SKILL.md/usage-guide/examples separation, unchanged from pre-fix; examples/pathway_analysis.R confirmed byte-identical and still independently runnable.

agent_specific.note: set.seed(123) guidance for mummichog is now present and independently verified to make PerformPSEA deterministic across two full runs; FELLA's approx='normality' analytic-determinism note is accurate and correctly avoids a misleading no-op seed. Up from 19/20 pre-fix.

recommendations.title: Reference-library downloads are an undisclosed network dependency
recommendations.problem: SetKEGG.PathLib(), CrossReferencing(), and Setup.KEGGReferenceMetabolome() all route through MetaboAnalystR's internal .get.my.lib(), which silently downloads generic pathway/compound reference libraries from https://www.metaboanalyst.ca/resources/libs/ whenever the local cache is missing or older than 30 days. This is not disclosed anywhere in SKILL.md/usage-guide.md, unlike the two fixed P0s and unlike FELLA's/KEGGREST's comparable live-network caveats, which ARE disclosed.
recommendations.root_cause: The Version Compatibility disclosure block added in the last fix pass covered only the two functions the fixer was explicitly told about (CalculateOraScore/CalculateQeaScore); it was not extended to the library-loading functions that also reach out to a remote server.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence to Version Compatibility or Prerequisites noting that SetKEGG.PathLib/CrossReferencing/Setup.KEGGReferenceMetabolome download generic (non-user) reference libraries from metaboanalyst.ca on first use or after a 30-day cache expiry, mirroring the existing FELLA/KEGGREST live-dependency disclosure.

recommendations.title: Primary ORA code block is a signposted dead end before the working fix
recommendations.problem: A user who runs only the first ('official') ORA code block in SKILL.md, including the documented Setup.KEGGReferenceMetabolome() addition, still ends at a clean but unresolved failure; the actually-working Local-Only ORA function appears later in the same section and requires reading past the failure to find it.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix correctly added a working local alternative but kept the known-broken official path as the code block's primary example, with the alternative subordinated below it.
recommendations.fix: Consider swapping the order: lead with Local-Only ORA as the default background-corrected path, and present the official MetaboAnalystR API path as the (currently broken) alternative for users who accept the xialab.ca data-sharing tradeoff.

recommendations.title: Mummichog's automatic duplicate-merging QC step is undocumented in prose
recommendations.problem: Read.PeakListData/SanityCheckMummichogData silently merge duplicate m/z-matched features (observed: 'A total of 11/111/11/11 of duplicates were merged' across four merge passes on the 1500-feature input) with no mention of this behavior in SKILL.md or usage-guide.md.
recommendations.root_cause: The Common Errors table documents input-shape pitfalls but not automatic data-transformation steps performed inside the call.
recommendations.fix: Add one line to the Mummichog/PSEA section noting that duplicate m/z-matched features are automatically merged before enrichment, so reported feature counts may differ from the input row count.
